sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Replace the presence-only checks with a formula-derived constraint implementing the UR S11.5.4.2 shear-stress calculation on the ship, using designVerticalIceShearForce in place of designVerticalWaveShearForce and validating appliedVerticalShearStress along the hull girder. Retrieve the missing canonical formula operands/location terms, preserve the supplied kN and MPa units, and compare the reported decimal result against a tolerance scaled from the expected formula result rather than exact equality.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The ship target, quantity datatypes, and units are valid, but the graph only checks presence of the input and result and therefore omits the required formula-derived constraint.
